channel.title: Live: European Athletics Championships
channel.desc: It's a huge night of action on the penultimate day of the European Athletics Championships, with nine new champions crowned in Birmingham. The final event of the heptathlon, the 800m, kicks off a busy evening session. There are medal chances in the women's high jump for Morgan Lake and in the women's 400 metres for Amber Anning, while the men's 1,500 metres sees Jake Wightman trying to add European gold to his world silver. And the night concludes with the men and women's sprint relay finals.
